questions.prompt: The repository currently names five meaningful subsystems: aios-ui, bin and services, docs, aios/context, and aios/context-loops. Should each receive a child Compass?
Should docs remain a source layer that informs other Compasses, or should the documentation/design-intent surface have its own child Compass with an independently maintained purpose?
Should the Context Compiler and context-loops be separate child Compasses with an explicit handoff, or one combined context-and-memory Compass?
What should AIOS's independently aligned boundaries optimize for after the current fold, regardless of the present directory layout?
Which AIOS capabilities deserve separate product truth because they have an independently meaningful user-visible outcome or drift risk?
Should documentation, skills, configuration, and specifications remain source/contract layers, or should any own an independently maintained Compass?
Should context compilation, context loops, dashboard observability, and local automation be separated, grouped, or remain root-scoped?
Which current child-boundary proposals should be preserved, redirected, retired, or left unknown after this reassessment?
What evidence should prove that any chosen AIOS boundary structure is aligned in real use?
